liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bobby McGee** (1 review): Reviewer doubts the band had previously opened a show with this song [6]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Unusually, this one seems to have only drums, vocals and Jerry in the mix [5]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Described as a great version, with Phil's bass prominent throughout [2]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Singled out as full-on, along with Not Fade Away [7]

## The recordings

- **gd72-11-12.sbd.cotsman.9771.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 170 min; rated 3/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals sit very low in the mix, though the instrumental playing comes through clearly; Instrumental mix and levels are also poor, so the reviewer considers it for completists only; Severe mix problems: mostly guitars and bass, little vocals or drums, no keys, and saturated bass in places [1][2][3][5][9][12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes this was the only Dead show on their birthday, and it was in their hometown of Kansas City [4]
- Reviewer hears a sad mood, wondering if it relates to news that Allman Brothers bassist Berry Oakley died the day before [6]
- The Dead were due to begin a joint tour with the Allman Brothers in Texas days later [6]
- The second set is called creative, especially for those who prefer jamming over vocals [2]
- The skewed mix offers a rare chance to hear the interplay of Jerry, Bob and Phil [5]
- Seen as the start of another two weeks of strong touring, like 10/17-11/1 and 9/15-10/2 [7]
- The setlist is said to contain many uncommon aspects, and the show is considered under the radar [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-11-12.sbd.cotsman.9771.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard recording, transferred via Mark Sweeney, with the chain SBD>MC>C>D>CD, and seeded to etree by J. Cotsman [1]

## Art and photos

- Photo by zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead 11/12/72 Soldiers & Sailors Memo…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/zoooma/3039306102/) [14]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/zoooma/3039306102/) [15]
